title: On the Existence and Asymptotic Behavior of Entire Positive Radial Solutions for Weighted Partial Trace Equations with Nonlinear Gradient Terms
content: In this study, we examine the existence of positive entire radial solutions for weighted partial trace equations with a nonlinear gradient term of the form \(\mathcal{P}_{\mathbf{a}}(D^2u)=h(|x|,u,|Du|)\) in \(\mathbb{R}^n\), where \(h\colon\mathbb{R}_0^+\times\mathbb{R}\times\mathbb{R}_0^+\to\mathbb{R}\) is a continuous function and \(\mathbf{a}=(a_1,\cdots,a_n)\) is an \(n\)-tuple of non-negative real numbers with \(a_1a_n>0\). \(\mathbb{R}^+\) and \(\mathbb{R}_0^+\) stand for \((0,\infty)\) and \([0,\infty)\), respectively.A Schauder-Tychonoff fixed point approach is used to prove the main results. We establish various conditions under which the equations have radial, strictly convex solutions \(u(x)\) in \(\mathbb{R}^n\) that are asymptotically constant multiples of \(|x|^2\) as \(|x|\to\infty\).
